term: respect independently pure of a candidate
definition: Something other than the candidate has the respect formally and is not composite. A classification that uses structure and cannot be met by the candidate's own row.
note: Open and unattributed as a criterion of what must be had formally. It yields a verdict only from which other beings the table has. See docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md.
